text:
gina.ops: FYI - customers reporting a spike in 4xx errors from /v1/rerank and /v1/score endpoints starting ~11:02 UTC. Error payloads show JSON parse failures on function-calling fields. Opening incident: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3312345678

dev-sam: Seeing same in traces. A subset of requests include `functions` objects where `arguments` are sent as bare strings instead of JSON objects (sdk v0.9.2 reported in user agents). Server strict-validate is rejecting with 400.

sdk-qa: We reproduced with the SDK pinned to v0.9.2 + using `client.callFunction(name, args)` with stringified args. Looks like a regression in the SDK shim that used to JSON.parse args but recent change left them raw.

sre-hyun: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) deploy server-side tolerant parser that attempts JSON.parse on `arguments` when content-type=application/json; 2) add a telemetry flag to surface orgs using broken SDK; 3) publish advisory to affected customers. Start canary tolerant parser in hosted-us-east1 (5%).

deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime/parse-tolerant-canary us-east1=5% (tg: runtime-rolling)

sre-hyun: Canary telemetry (6m): 4xx from rerank dropped ~82% on canary nodes. No CPU/mem change. Proceeding to 25% after quick checks.

cs-rachel: Pulling list of orgs that spiked errors for proactive outreach. Draft status note for affected customers and recommended workaround: upgrade SDK to v0.9.3 (patch releasing shortly).

sdk-qa: Patch v0.9.3 created to reinstate JSON.parse behavior and add defensive tests. Will push to npm and pypi within 15m.

dev-sam: Rolling tolerant parser to 100% in hosted regions as a temporary bridge while SDK rollout completes. Will annotate logs with `tolerant_parse=true` when we accept a stringified arg.

sre-hyun: 100% rollout complete at 3312345842. Error rates back to baseline. Monitoring for 30m.

status-page-bot: Public status: "Mitigated Customers may have seen 4xx errors on rerank/score routes due to malformed function-calling payloads from older SDKs. A tolerant parser was deployed and SDK patch released. Please upgrade to SDK v0.9.3. Full postmortem forthcoming." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3312345678

cs-rachel: Sending targeted emails to affected orgs with rollback/upgrade guidance and offer to assist.

sdk-qa: Action items: 1) ship v0.9.3 (urgent), 2) add CI test for function-calling arg types, 3) add server-side linting rule to detect client SDK regressions earlier.

dev-sam: Postmortem owners: eng-sdk (sdk-qa), eng-runtime (dev-sam), eng-sre (sre-hyun), customer-success (cs-rachel). Postmortem ETA: 72h.

gina.ops: Thanks team. Final public update will go out after the monitoring window. If anyone sees residual customer impact, page oncall. :thumbsup:
